text.app.name: Nemura
text.signin.title: Sign in
text.signin.lead: Sign in with your company account. Nemura never asks for your NRIC to sign in.
text.signin.none: No way to sign in is set up yet. Ask whoever runs Nemura for your company.
text.signin.notSetUp: Nemura is not set up yet. The person who installs it creates the first organisation with the one-time setup code; after that you can sign in.
text.signin.invite: New here? Your company sends you an invitation. Open it after you sign in.
text.signin.loading: Checking how you can sign in
text.signin.failed: We could not reach Nemura. Check your connection and try again.
text.signin.art.lead: Your leave, your pay, your letters. One place.
text.signin.art.label: About Nemura
text.signin.art.leave: Apply for leave in under a minute
text.signin.art.letters: Letters for the bank, a landlord or a visa
text.home.noRoles: You have no role yet. Ask the Owner to give you one.
text.home.soon: Your leave, pay and letters appear here as each is switched on for your company.
text.notfound.title: There is nothing at this address
text.notfound.fix: Go to your home page and start again.
text.review.heading: Needs additional verification
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_01: That way of signing in does not exist. Choose one of the buttons below.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_02: The sign-in took too long, or started in another browser. Start again here.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_03: The sign-in provider's answer did not pass its checks. Try again; if it keeps happening, tell whoever runs Nemura.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_04: We could not reach the sign-in provider. Try again in a moment.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_05: Your account is not a member of any organisation here. Ask your company for an invitation, then choose I have an invitation.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_06: Sign-out was sent from another site. Sign out from Nemura itself.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_07: Nemura is not set up yet. Choose Set up Nemura and use the one-time setup code.
text.signin.error.NM_SIGNIN_08: That code is wrong, was used already or has expired. Check it, or ask for a new one.
text.join.lead.setup: The person who installs Nemura creates the first organisation with the one-time setup code, and becomes its Owner.
text.join.lead.invitation: Use the code in your invitation. It works once, for you, and expires.
text.join.name: Your name
text.join.help: You sign in with the provider next, and the code is used once, with the account you sign in with.
text.join.noProvider: No way to sign in is set up yet. Ask whoever runs Nemura.
text.join.lead.recovery: Two operators of this installation issued you a one-time recovery code. Sign in with the account you will keep from now on: every other sign-in, session and passkey of yours ends.

text.directory.lead: Everyone who works here today, with their job and manager.

text.packs.lead: The statutory facts Nemura uses, each with the official page it comes from. A value that is only researched has not been checked by a second person: your company decides whether to use it.
text.packs.notice: Accepting a version verifies nothing: the pack's publisher does.

text.packs.failed: We could not save that. Check your connection and try again.

text.policy.lead: Your company's entitlements. Each is checked against the statute: giving less is refused, giving more is welcome.

text.policy.annual.help: Separate days with commas: the first year, the second, and so on. The last repeats.

text.sick.lead: Sick leave is not applied for: tell the company, and give the medical certificate when you are back. Nobody approves it.

text.calendar.failed: The calendar could not be shown.

text.gov.lead: Each block of maternity, paternity or shared parental leave with its claim deadline and the employer's claims. Claims are filed on the Government-Paid Leave portal by a person; Nemura keeps the record and moves no money.

text.requests.lead: Where your requests are: leave and flexible work. A flexible work request is a formal one: the company answers it in writing within two months.

text.ot.title: Hours worked on special days
text.ot.lead: For Part IV employees: overtime, work on a rest day and work on a public holiday, entered by the day. Your manager or the people team approves it, and a pay run uses it once.

text.accrual.lead: The carried-forward annual leave still untaken, per person. Nemura keeps the days; the amounts and the journal come from payroll and the Fyniq link.

text.deleg.lead: The Owner can let a standard letter be issued at once, signed in their name, to employees who are not serving notice. A letter that shows pay is never issued this way, and a change to the template ends the delegation.

text.plans.lead: A plan is made for each person who joins, from a template: tasks for HR, their manager, IT and the joiner, each due a number of days from their start date.

text.plans.none: No plan has been made yet.

text.hiring.none: No requisition has been asked for yet.

text.assistant.lead: The assistant answers questions from a person's own records and the pack, and drafts letters and replies for the people team to edit and approve. It is off until the Owner turns it on.
text.assistant.neverList: It never approves or refuses leave or a request, changes pay, a bank account, a role or a record, issues or signs a letter, moves a candidate, decides a hiring, a rating, a promotion or a termination, or reads another person's restricted data. It proposes; a named person decides.

text.link.clientKey: Nemura's client key (public, shown now only)
text.link.approve: Finish the link with Fyniq's half
text.link.approveLead: Another Owner or an Administrator than the one who proposed, with a passkey. Copy each value from Fyniq's People and HR page.
text.link.fyniqClientId: The ID Nemura's client has at Fyniq's OAuth server
text.link.approveButton: Finish the link with my passkey
text.link.keysNotJson: A key is not JSON: copy the whole key as Fyniq shows it.
text.link.clients: API clients registered before the link
text.link.clientsLead: The two people who approve the link review these: each already has a way in, and from now on another Owner or Administrator approves any new one.
text.link.failing: The link has not synced since {since}. Read why below, put it right and send again.
text.link.counts: Waiting {queued}, not delivered yet {failed}, sent {sent}, refused {refused}.
text.link.checkpoint: Checkpoint: queued up to {queued}, sent up to {sent}, received from Fyniq up to {received}.
text.link.undelivered: What was not delivered, newest first
text.link.repair: Send the current state to Fyniq again
text.link.repaired: Queued {n} events: Fyniq ignores what it holds and applies what it missed.
text.verify.title: Verify a letter
text.verify.lead: Enter the reference and the verification code printed on the letter. This shows only whether the company issued it and it stands, what kind of letter it is, the day it was issued and the company. It shows nothing of the person or the letter's words.
text.verify.failed: That could not be checked just now. Try again in a while.
text.verify.notFound: Nothing matches that reference and code. Check them against the letter, exactly as printed.
text.verify.withdrawn: Withdrawn: do not rely on this letter
text.erasure.title: Erase a former employee's data
text.erasure.denied: Only an Owner or an HR administrator sees erasures.
text.erasure.lead: A former employee's personal data is erased once the retention periods have run: one year after leaving for the employment records and five years from the relevant Year of Assessment for the payroll records. An Owner or an HR administrator asks, and a second one approves, each with a passkey.
text.erasure.asked: Asked for. A second Owner or HR administrator approves it.
text.erasure.approved: Approved. The data is erased shortly and the register keeps a signed record.
text.erasure.none: No erasure has been asked for.
text.erasure.keeps: What the database keeps append-only (issued letters, payslip figures, pay run lines, leave and sick notes) stays tied to the person's ID, with no name; the people team decides how it is shredded.
text.link.bankReconfirm.title: Bank details to confirm again
text.link.bankReconfirm.lead: After a restore, Fyniq holds bank details for these people that this database does not have. No payment is made to them until their bank account is changed and confirmed again: propose it on their record, have a second person approve it, and the employee confirms it with a passkey.
text.link.restore.title: After a restore
text.link.restore.lead: Nemura's database was restored by {by} ({at}). The link is held: nothing is sent or paid until each run below is decided against Fyniq's own record.
text.link.restore.checkpoint: Checkpoint of the restored database: queued up to {queued}, sent up to {sent}, received from Fyniq up to {received}.
text.link.restore.run: Run {run}, version {version}: Fyniq may have posted it after the restore point.
text.link.restore.outcome.not_posted: Not posted in Fyniq: the approval is sent again.
text.link.restore.decided: Decided. The link resumes when every run is decided.
text.link.restore.resumed: Reconciled. The link is active and the current state is on its way to Fyniq.
text.approval.linked.title: Approve with proof for Fyniq
text.approval.linked.lead: Nemura is linked to Fyniq, so this run is approved with proof: you read the figures Fyniq will post, and your passkey signs their digest. Fyniq checks your signature before it posts anything.
text.approval.linked.mapping: Wage month {month}, calculated against Fyniq's account mapping version {version}.
text.approval.linked.totals: Employee CPF {ee}, employer CPF {er}, SDL {sdl}, self-help group funds {shg}, claims paid with the salary {reimbursements}.
text.approval.linked.digest: Digest of these figures, which your passkey signs: {digest}
text.approval.linked.enrol: Sign with the passkey you enrolled in Fyniq. If you have not enrolled one, sign in to Fyniq once and add a passkey in its security settings: Fyniq cannot verify an approval without it.
text.approval.linked.passkeyMissing: Fyniq knows you and says you have no passkey enrolled there. Sign in to Fyniq, add a passkey in its security settings, then come back: Fyniq will refuse this approval until you have one.
text.approval.linked.passkeyUnknown: Fyniq has not said whether you have a passkey enrolled there. If you have never signed in to Fyniq, ask its Owner to invite you, then add a passkey there: Fyniq will refuse an approval it cannot check.
text.approval.linked.approve: Confirm, sign the figures and approve version {version}
text.approval.linked.signFailed: The passkey did not sign the figures. Try again with the passkey you enrolled in Fyniq, and confirm with your fingerprint, face or PIN.
text.approval.linked.done: Approved with proof. Nemura is sending it to Fyniq: its answer shows below.
text.approval.linked.state.none: Version {version} has not been sent to Fyniq yet.
text.approval.linked.state.queued: Version {version} is waiting to be sent to Fyniq.
text.approval.linked.state.sent: Version {version} was sent to Fyniq and is waiting for its answer.
text.approval.linked.state.failed: Version {version} could not be delivered yet ({code}). Nemura tries again.
text.approval.linked.state.refused: Fyniq refused version {version} on the way in ({code}).
text.approval.linked.refused: Fyniq refused to post it ({code}): {message} The run waits.
text.approval.linked.enrolFix: The approver has no passkey in Fyniq. Sign in to Fyniq, add a passkey in its security settings, then select Send again.
text.approval.linked.sentAgain: Sent again. Fyniq's answer shows here.
text.statutory.title: Files for CPF and IRAS
text.statutory.lead: The CPF EZPay file and the IR8A payload for the Auto-Inclusion Scheme, made from the approved version. Each holds NRICs, so it asks for your passkey. A file is never proof that anything was submitted.
text.statutory.failed: The file could not be made. Check the details and try again.
text.statutory.cpf.title: CPF EZPay file
text.statutory.cpf.type: Payment type of your CPF Submission Number (three letters or digits)
text.statutory.ais.title: IR8A for the Auto-Inclusion Scheme
text.exports.title: Files for the books and the bank
text.exports.lead: Standalone, Nemura makes a journal file and a bank payment file of the approved version as CSV, with a manifest kept: the run, the version, the totals and the SHA-256 of the exact file. A file is never proof of payment: a payment is paid only when the bank feed matches it or you record the outcome with evidence. The payment file holds bank account numbers, so it asks for your passkey.
text.payments.title: Payments
text.payments.attention: Look at this: rejected, returned or unknown
text.payments.mismatch: Paid an amount other than the one owed
text.payments.lead: Paid means paid: record it with a document of the person that shows it, such as a bank statement line. A file or a posted journal is never proof. An unknown outcome blocks a new payment of that person until you record whether it was paid, rejected or returned.
text.payments.evidence: Evidence: a document of the person
text.payments.noEvidence: This person has no document to use as evidence: add one to their documents first.
text.payments.failed: We could not record that. Check the fields and try again.
text.mypay.nextNone: Your next pay day is not set yet: ask the people team.
text.mypay.forms: Tax forms: none is ready yet. The year-end form appears here when it is.
text.mypay.title: My pay
text.mypay.lead: Your payslips by month. Only yours: nobody sees them but you and the people who run payroll.
text.mypay.none: No payslip has been published for you yet.
text.mypay.failed: We could not open it. Check your connection and try again.
text.mypay.notfound: There is no such payslip of yours.
text.payslip.title: Payslip for {month}
text.payslip.reimbursements: Reimbursements paid with the salary (not part of the salary)
text.payslip.corrected: A corrected payslip replaces this one: read the newer one.
text.approval.published: Published: {n} payslips are in each person's My pay.
text.letters.failed: We could not show the letters. Check your connection and try again.
text.letters.hash: The signatory confirms this hash of the exact PDF: {sha}
text.letters.refused: Refused, and the person is told why.
text.letters.passkeyFailed: The passkey was not confirmed, so nothing was signed.
text.letters.link: Make a link that works for seven days
text.letters.noneMine: You have asked for no letters.
text.request.title: Ask for a letter
text.request.lead: Choose the letter and say what it is for. The people team checks it and the signatory signs it. A letter shows only facts of your record.
text.request.none: The company issues no letters yet. Ask the people team.
text.tpl.title: Letter templates
text.tpl.lead: The letterhead, which letters the company issues, and each letter's template: blocks of text with merge fields, a draft until the HR administrator approves it.
text.tpl.name: Company name
text.tpl.needs: Needs the person's {needs}, which Nemura does not hold yet.
text.tpl.failed: We could not save that. Check your connection and try again.
text.tpl.block.heading: Heading
text.verify.fileLead: Or choose the letter as a file. Your browser sends only its fingerprint (a SHA-256), never the file.
text.verify.fileFailed: That file could not be read here. Try the reference and code instead.
text.verify.disclosureTitle: What the letter says about the person
text.verify.disclosureLead: The person this letter is about shared these facts with you. The link stops working on {when}.
text.verify.disclosureNone: This link does not work: it may have expired, or the person revoked it. Ask them for a new one.
text.verify.disclosureWithdrawn: The person withdrew the verification of this letter, so its facts are not shown. Do not rely on the letter.
text.letters.unverified: The verification is withdrawn: anyone who looks the letter up is told so.
text.letters.share: Share what it says about me
text.letters.shared: Link: {url}. It shows what this letter says about you until {when}, or until you revoke it. It is shown once; copy it now.
text.letters.revokedNote: The link is revoked. The letter and its verification are unchanged.
text.concerns.title: Raise a concern in confidence
text.concerns.lead: Tell us about something at work that is not right. Only the HR administrator or the Owner who looks into it reads it, and never anyone it is about. You will read the written outcome here.
text.concerns.summary: What happened, when and who was there
text.concerns.aboutHelp: Choose up to five people, or leave it empty when it is about how things are done. The people you name can never read it.
text.concerns.failed: We could not do that. Check your connection and try again.
text.concerns.filedWaiting: Sent. Everyone who could look into it is involved, so it waits for someone who is not; you will see here when it is taken.
text.concerns.none: You have not raised a concern.
text.grievances.title: Grievances
text.grievances.denied: Only an HR administrator or the Owner handles grievances.
text.grievances.lead: The concerns raised in confidence that you look into. You see only those you are not involved in, and nobody it is about ever sees one. Reading one is recorded.
text.grievances.waitingLead: Either nobody who is not involved could handle these when they were raised, or the person handling one has left. You are neither the person who raised it nor involved, so you may read one and take it. Reading the inquiry record waits until it is yours.
text.grievances.reason.unrouted: Waiting: nobody who is not involved could take it
text.grievances.outcomeLabel: The outcome, which the person who raised it reads
text.grievances.decided: The outcome is written and the person who raised it can read it.
text.grievances.passed: Passed on. You no longer read it.
text.grievances.failed: We could not do that. Check your connection and try again.

signin.page.label: Sign in
signin.page.tooltip: Sign in to Nemura with the account your company set up. A passkey confirms it is you for sensitive changes, not to sign in.

home.me.label: My home
home.me.tooltip: Where you start: your own leave, pay and letters, and what waits for you.

home.people.label: People home
home.people.tooltip: Where the people team starts: who is away, what waits for approval and the checks that need you.

nav.signOut.label: Sign out
nav.signOut.tooltip: Ends this session on this device. Other devices stay signed in until you sign out there.

review.awaiting-verification.label: Needs additional verification
review.awaiting-verification.tooltip: The rules this page uses have not had their second review yet. Check what it shows before you rely on it.

join.page.label: Join
join.page.tooltip: Take your place in Nemura with the code you were given: an invitation's, or the one-time setup code for the first organisation.

directory.page.label: People
directory.page.tooltip: Everyone who works here on a day, with their job, department and manager. Nothing restricted is shown here.

person.page.label: A person
person.page.tooltip: One person's record: contact, job history and, for the people team, their legal classification. A job change starts a new record from a day; it never edits the old one.

features.page.label: Features
features.page.tooltip: Each optional feature is on, off, or held by another system. A feature another one needs cannot be switched off, and switching off keeps the records.

new.page.label: Add a person
new.page.tooltip: Adds a person with their first job from their start date. Only the HR officer and the HR administrator add people.

packs.page.label: Country pack
packs.page.tooltip: The statutory facts Nemura uses, with the official page of each. Researched values have not been checked by a second person; your company records a decision to use them.

policy.page.label: Leave policy
policy.page.tooltip: Your company's leave entitlements on top of the statute. A policy that gives less than the statute for any rule is refused, naming the rule.

leave.page.label: My leave
leave.page.tooltip: Your leave balance for the year: entitled, taken, booked and left, with the steps of the calculation and where each figure comes from.

apply.page.label: Apply for leave
apply.page.tooltip: Ask for leave in under a minute: see the cost, your balance after the request and who else is away, then send it to your manager.

team.page.label: Team leave
team.page.tooltip: Approve or refuse the leave your reports asked for. A refusal needs a reason; you cannot decide your own request.

sick.page.label: Tell us you're sick
sick.page.tooltip: Tell the company you are sick: no approval. Paid days come out of the sick leave limit in force each day; give the medical certificate when you are back.

gov.page.label: Government-paid leave
gov.page.tooltip: Maternity, paternity and shared parental leave under the country pack's rules, with the employer's reimbursement claims and their deadlines. Nothing here moves money.

requests.page.label: My requests
requests.page.tooltip: Your leave and flexible work requests and where each is. A formal flexible work request is answered in writing within two months.

ot.page.label: Hours worked
ot.page.tooltip: Overtime, rest-day and public-holiday work for Part IV employees, entered by the day without clocking and approved before a pay run uses it.

letters.page.label: Letters
letters.page.tooltip: Requests for letters. The people team checks each one; the signatory signs the exact PDF with a passkey, and the letter is kept as evidence.

request.page.label: Ask for a letter
request.page.tooltip: Ask for an employment confirmation or another letter. It shows only facts of your record and needs the people team's check and the signatory's signature.

terms.page.label: Key employment terms
terms.page.tooltip: The terms the Employment Act asks the employer to give in writing within 14 days of the start. The people team writes the base terms; only the Payroll administrator and the Owner see and write the pay.

details.page.label: My details
details.page.tooltip: Change your contact details and emergency contacts at once. A change of legal name, residency or NRIC or FIN needs evidence and approval, and never holds the number.

ask.page.label: Ask a question
ask.page.tooltip: Ask the people team a question in writing. Someone other than you answers it, and the answer shows under My requests.

queue.page.label: Requests
queue.page.tooltip: What waits for the people team: changes of details to approve with their evidence, and questions to answer. Nobody decides their own.

leaver.page.label: My documents
leaver.page.tooltip: After your last day this account keeps your own documents and letters until the record-keeping period ends. You can ask the people team for a copy of one you lost.

careers.settings.label: Careers page
careers.settings.tooltip: Choose the address of your public list of open roles and switch it on or off. It shows each published post's title, team, text and day, and never a salary or a person.

pipeline.add.label: Add a candidate
pipeline.add.tooltip: Adds a candidate to an approved requisition. Applying is taken as consent to assessing the application; keeping them for future roles needs their separate consent, which they can withdraw.

pipeline.kit.label: Interview kit
pipeline.kit.tooltip: The questions and the scorecard's criteria for a role. Questions are checked against the Tripartite Guidelines like a job post; a flagged one stays only with the genuine requirement recorded.

careers.page.label: Careers
careers.page.tooltip: The company's open roles, written by the company. Nothing here is a promise of a job; each role says what the company asks for.

hiring.page.label: Hiring
hiring.page.tooltip: Requisitions the Owner approves and a job post for each, checked for wording the guidelines ask employers to avoid, with the advert dates the Fair Consideration Framework asks for.

goals.page.label: My goals
goals.page.tooltip: The company's, the teams' and your own goals with their key results and your role KPIs. Progress is exact and rounded down; you update a key result with the value now.

onb.page.label: Joiners and leavers
onb.page.tooltip: The invitation tasks and onboarding plans for new people and the dates, checklist and leave settlement of people who are leaving. The dates that start statutory clocks are kept apart.

payroll.page.label: Payroll
payroll.page.tooltip: Pay groups, each person's pay record, the year to date and one-off items. Pay is seen and changed by the Payroll administrator and the Owner alone, and no audit event holds an amount.

workspace.switch.label: Finance | People switch
workspace.switch.tooltip: Crosses to Fyniq with the same account. It never changes what you may do: each app keeps its own roles and its own last page.

link.page.label: Link to Fyniq
link.page.tooltip: How Nemura and Fyniq work together: one Owner proposes the link and another person approves it; then the people, bank-detail versions, holds and approved pay runs go to Fyniq, signed, and Fyniq's departments come here. Nothing sensitive is sent.

link.health.label: How the link is doing
link.health.tooltip: Events waiting, not delivered yet, sent and refused, the last one sent, and the checkpoint of what was queued, sent and received. A sync that has failed for 24 hours shows on Checks.

link.repair.label: Send the current state again
link.repair.tooltip: Repairs a gap: sends each person's present record, bank-detail version and hold again and what failed. Fyniq ignores a version it already holds, so it is safe to repeat.

verify.page.label: Verify a letter
verify.page.tooltip: Enter the reference and the verification code printed on a letter to learn whether the company issued it and it stands. It shows only the kind of letter, the day and the company.

erasure.page.label: Erase a former employee's data
erasure.page.tooltip: Asks for a former employee's personal data to be erased after its retention periods. A second Owner or HR administrator approves. A legal hold or an unanswered access request stops it. Records the database keeps append-only stay, without the name.

link.bankReconfirm.label: Bank details to confirm again
link.bankReconfirm.tooltip: After a restore, Fyniq may hold a version of a person's bank details that this database lost. Their payments wait until a new change of their bank account is approved and confirmed by the employee; it is numbered above Fyniq's.

link.restore.label: After a restore
link.restore.tooltip: When Nemura's database is restored, the link is held until each run Fyniq may have posted after the restore point is decided against Fyniq's own record. Then it resumes.

approval.proof.label: Approve with proof
approval.proof.tooltip: While Nemura is linked to Fyniq you sign the figures Fyniq will post with the passkey you enrolled in Fyniq. Fyniq checks the signature, so nothing posts on Nemura's word alone.

approval.page.label: Approve a pay run
approval.page.tooltip: Read the run's digest, flags, overrides and what changed since last month, then confirm with your passkey. The person who prepared the version cannot approve it.

assistant.page.label: The people assistant
assistant.page.tooltip: What the assistant may draft, off until the Owner turns it on, and the drafts it proposed for a person to approve. It never approves, issues, pays or changes a record.

askai.page.label: Ask the assistant
askai.page.tooltip: Ask about your own leave, your pay day, a rule of the Singapore pack or a line of your payslip. Each answer says where it comes from; the assistant never approves, changes or pays anything.

mypay.page.label: My pay
mypay.page.tooltip: Your payslips by month, each with MOM's twelve items, a print view and a PDF. They are yours alone.

tpl.page.label: Letter templates
tpl.page.tooltip: Set the letterhead, switch letter types on and write their templates. A template is a draft until the HR administrator approves it; a published version never changes.

verify.file.label: Compare a document
verify.file.tooltip: Choose the letter as a file to learn whether it is the one the company issued. Your browser works out the file's SHA-256 and sends only that: the file never leaves your device.

letters.unverify.label: Withdraw verification
letters.unverify.tooltip: Anyone who looks this letter up is told its verification is withdrawn, and any link you shared stops showing facts. The letter itself stays as issued.

letters.share.label: Share what it says about me
letters.share.tooltip: Makes a link that shows the facts this letter states about you for the days you choose. Only you can make or revoke it, and revoking it never withdraws the letter.

concerns.page.label: Raise a concern in confidence
concerns.page.tooltip: Raise something at work that is not right. Only the HR administrator or the Owner who looks into it reads it, never anyone it is about. You read the written outcome here.

grievances.page.label: Grievances
grievances.page.tooltip: The concerns raised in confidence that you handle: the inquiry record, passing one on and writing the outcome. You never see one you are involved in, and nobody it is about sees any.
